items.title: Ed Shaughnessy Part I interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 1, 1995 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: He has recorded with jazz greats Oliver Nelson, Quincy Jones, Zoot Sims and Wes Montgomery.

ctx.x: Ed Shaughnessy may be the most familiar drummer in the country. His dynamic playing and vivacious personality have sparked the bands of Jack Teagarden, Benny Goodman, Duke Ellington and George Shearing. A native of Jersey City, Ed’s first playing experience was in the clubs of the flourishing jazz scene on New York’s 52nd Street. In the 50’s he was kept busy in the studios and as a staff drummer with CBS television. As the Tonight Show drummer, Ed became a familiar face with nation-wide audiences and moved to Los…
Ed was interviewed in Los Angeles on September 1, 1995 by Monk Rowe, director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
